settings.overviewDescription: Welcome and goodbye messages, with an optional random-GIF pool. Save GIFs by right-clicking a message and picking the "Save GIF" app command.

descriptions.embed: The name of a saved embed from the embed builder.
descriptions.components: The name of a saved message from the component builder - takes priority over the saved embed.
descriptions.pingJoin: Mention the joining user above the message
descriptions.pingRoles: Roles to mention above the message
descriptions.pingUsers: Users to mention above the message
descriptions.botToken: Send greetings as your own bot instead of mine. Paste its token from the Discord Developer Portal, then invite that bot to this server.
descriptions.presenceType: What the bot appears to be doing.
descriptions.presenceText: The text shown after the activity type.
descriptions.presenceEmoji: Emoji shown beside a Custom status.
descriptions.profileNick: The nickname the bot uses in this server.
descriptions.profileAvatar: Server-specific avatar. Paste a Discord image link.
descriptions.profileBanner: Server-specific banner. Paste a Discord image link.
descriptions.inviteBot: Get an invite link for your custom bot.
descriptions.clearToken: Remove the custom bot and go back to the default bot.
descriptions.profileBio: Short bio on the bot profile in this server. Discord does not report it back, so this box always looks empty even once set.

actions.testDesc: Sends the real message to the configured channel, treating you as the member
actions.gifsDesc: Attach a random saved GIF to every message. Save GIFs by right-clicking any message with an image and picking the "Save GIF" app command.

test.failed: Nothing sent - set a channel and make sure the referenced saved message still exists.

reasons.customBotOnly: Set a custom bot token first.
reasons.customStatusOnly: Only available with the Custom activity type.

settings.profileWriteFailed: I could not update the profile. Check my permissions and try again.
settings.presenceEmojiNotFound: No emoji named {{name}} in this server.
settings.inviteBotText: Use the button below to add your bot to this server.
settings.inviteBotNoToken: Set a custom bot token first.
settings.clearTokenDone: Custom bot removed. Greetings will use the default bot again.

guide.title: Welcome Setup Guide
guide.intro: Work through the sections below. Each section goes live the moment you turn it on.
guide.advertText: **New here?** The Setup Guide walks you through welcome and goodbye messages.

sectionDesc.welcome: Greet members the moment they join. Without a saved embed or CV2 message, a simple default text is used. Saved GIFs are attached automatically, or place one yourself with the gif placeholder.
sectionDesc.goodbye: Send a message when members leave.

gates.goodbye: Do you want a message sent when members leave?

errors.embedNotFound: No saved embed with that name exists.
errors.componentsNotFound: No saved CV2 message with that name exists.
errors.manageGuildRequired: You need the Manage Server permission to do that.

gifs.count: {{total}} saved - page {{page}} of {{pages}}. A random one is attached to every message.
gifs.empty: Nothing saved yet. Right-click any message with an image and pick the "Save GIF" app command.
gifs.noneFound: That message has no images I can save.
gifs.alreadySaved: That image is already in the pool.
gifs.embedPending: Discord hasn't loaded this link's preview yet. Wait for the GIF to appear, then try again.

botToken.invalid: That token was rejected by Discord. Copy it again from the Developer Portal.
botToken.keyMissing: I could not securely store that token. Please report this.
